spec.niche: public astronomy observatory offering stargazing nights, astrophotography courses, and planetarium shows

design_system.layout_style: deep-space dark theme with constellation line accents and large astronomical imagery

page_descriptions.home: Full-bleed hero with deep-space nebula imagery placeholder, observatory name in elegant serif overlay, current moon phase indicator widget in corner, 'Tonight's Sky' CTA. Below: three columns showing 'What's Visible Tonight' with celestial object cards (planet, constellation, deep-sky object), upcoming events strip with date badges, brief mission statement with telescope dome photo placeholder, testimonial quotes from visitors set against starfield background
page_descriptions.events: Calendar grid view with event dots on dates, list view toggle, event cards (date, time, title, type tag like 'Stargazing Night' or 'Meteor Shower Watch', weather suitability indicator, ticket price, capacity remaining bar), filter sidebar for event type and difficulty level, featured event hero at top with countdown timer placeholder
page_descriptions.courses: Course catalog with category tabs (Beginner Astronomy, Astrophotography, Telescope Operation, Cosmology), each course card has duration, sessions count, instructor portrait, skill level badge with constellation icons, price, enrollment status. Detailed syllabus accordion for expanded cards, instructor bio sidebar with credentials
page_descriptions.planetarium: Show schedule with poster-style cards for each planetarium feature (title, runtime, age rating, brief synopsis), full-dome show trailer placeholder video frames, dome theater specifications panel, seat selection map placeholder, school group booking section with form
page_descriptions.visit: Practical info with hours table (open hours vary by season), directions with map placeholder, parking and accessibility info, dark-sky etiquette guidelines in callout box, ticket pricing table, FAQ accordion, photo gallery of observatory facilities placeholder
page_descriptions.membership: Three membership tiers (Stargazer, Astronomer, Patron) as elevated cards with starfield backgrounds, benefits comparison table, member testimonial section, gift membership option, donor recognition wall with engraved-style name list

special_elements: constellation line decorative dividers between sections
live moon phase widget in header
weather suitability indicators for outdoor events
celestial object info cards with magnitude/distance data
starfield particle backgrounds on dark sections
spec.responsive_notes: Mobile: calendar collapses to scrollable list view, course cards stack full-width, membership tiers stack vertically with sticky compare button, hero text scales down significantly. Tablet: 2-column event grid, side-by-side course details, planetarium poster cards in 2-col grid

defects.description: The 'What's Visible Tonight' section header is misspelled as 'What's Visable Tonight' in the prominent column heading
The calendar grid on the events page does not collapse to list view on mobile — it remains a 7-column grid causing the date cells to shrink to unreadable widths and event dots to overlap
The Astronomer tier card (middle tier) uses a bright cyan accent color (#06D6A0) for its CTA button instead of the site-wide gold accent (#F4C95D) used on the other two tier cards

Long instructor names with credentials (e.g., 'Dr. Annaliese Thornwood-Battista, PhD') overflow the instructor portrait card on tablet viewports, breaking out of the rounded card border on the right side
